author: indoorsman
quote:
GTA 6 represents all the worst aspects of the modern games industry. Bloated budget, over priced, technologically sloppy, 30 fps, digital only, gameplay second, manufactuted hype, preorder focused. Paying money for this enables all those things. This is the trojan horse for all the worst practices.

This is not the Rockstar from our childhood. Look at early 2000s Rockstar staff photos compared to now. These people hate you. They hate the demographic this game traditionally attracts and they're laughing at you as they scam you out of $80 for a non-refundable, non-sellable humiliation ritual simulator download code.

These are the guys that couldn't even get a remaster for the three most critically acclaimed games of all time right. I mean how do you manage to **** up that lay up? You think a 2 billion dollar budget makes for a good game? Is your favorite movie James Cameron's Avatar? There's no world where a game with that much money behind it can be something worth playing.

Go buy an indie game.
